title: JulixEconomyPlugin
body:
🌍 SimpleEconomy – Lightweight Economy Plugin for Paper 1.21.x
SimpleEconomy is a minimal yet powerful economy plugin built for Paper 1.21.x servers. It is designed to be fast, easy to configure, and flexible enough to serve as the backbone of any server economy. Whether you want a simple balance system or a foundation for shops, jobs, and trading, SimpleEconomy provides the essentials without unnecessary complexity.

⚡ Key Features
- 📊 Player Accounts
Every player automatically receives an account with a configurable starting balance. This ensures fairness and consistency across your server economy.
- 💰 Core Commands
- /balance – Check your current balance.
- /money – Alternative command to view funds.
- /pay <player> <amount> – Transfer money to another player.
- 🔑 Admin Commands
- /money set <player> <amount> – Set a player’s balance.
- /money add <player> <amount> – Add funds to a player’s account.
- /money remove <player> <amount> – Deduct funds from a player’s account.
- 🗂️ Simple Data Storage
Balances are stored in a human‑readable YAML file (balances.yml). This makes it easy to back up, edit, or migrate data without needing a database.
- ⚙️ Extensible Architecture
- Ready for Vault integration so you can connect with shop plugins, jobs plugins, or other economy‑based systems.
- Can be extended to support databases (MySQL, SQLite, etc.) for larger servers.

🌟 Advantages
- Minimalistic & Performant – No unnecessary features, just the essentials.
- Easy to Configure – Simple YAML configuration, no complicated setup.
- Flexible Foundation – Perfect for shops, jobs, trading, or custom plugins.
- Beginner Friendly – Ideal for new server owners who want a quick economy solution.
- Developer Friendly – Clean codebase and extensible design for plugin developers.

📥 Installation
- Download the SimpleEconomy JAR file.
- Place it into the plugins/ folder of your Paper server.
- Restart the server.
- The file balances.yml will be automatically generated.
From here, players can immediately start using /balance, /pay, and /money. Admins can manage balances with the provided commands.

🔒 Permissions
- simpleeconomy.balance – Allows players to check their balance.
- simpleeconomy.pay – Allows players to send money to others.
- simpleeconomy.admin – Grants access to all admin commands.

🛠️ Example Use Cases
- Shops – Combine with a shop plugin to let players buy and sell items.
- Jobs – Reward players with money for completing tasks.
- Trading – Enable player‑to‑player transactions with /pay.
- Events & Rewards – Admins can easily add or remove funds for competitions or giveaways.

🚀 Future Plans
- Database support (MySQL, SQLite) for larger servers.
- Expanded Vault integration for compatibility with more plugins.
- Optional interest system or daily rewards.
- API hooks for developers to build custom features.
